lyon-beaujolais-golden-stone-roads-and-l.story: 623 km from Anse to Saint-Jean-de-Niost, about 11 h 05 of riding. On the way it passes Oingt golden village, Beaujeu vineyard roads, Mâcon river and in Saint-Jean-de-Niost. The climbs: in Roche-la-Molière, near La Côte-Saint-André and Scenic stretch in Saint-Jean-de-Bournay. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
